title: The front door says the new fee rules: no more tips on every tier, and one capped finder's fee on a customer the network sends

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-18: "Make sure you fully update every bit of copy on the site." ADR-1978. Owner 2026-11-19 05:49Z: authorized to push, merge, migrate and validate.

detail: / renders the published pages row (OWN-043), and that row said "Tips stay open on every tier, with no fee" and "Paid tickets and donations open at Business", measured in production 2026-11-19. DONE 2026-11-19: a guarded, idempotent data step rewrites the two lines to the ADR-1978 rule (a free Space comes with Crew and takes donations and tips, selling starts at Business, 0% on your own people plus card processing, one capped finder's fee once). It refuses if someone published other words since. Main-first: applied after merge, and `/` shows it within an hour or on the next deploy.

verify.note: Passes while the guarded data step carries the new money line and the template does not bring the old one back. Fails on main at a5684bf86 (no data step).
